items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1960-09-16
items.q: Trumpet, that's his son. That was his son.

ctx.x: Well he had about 14 pieces in his band in those days. Pretty big band and used violins. Used violins. He played violin himself. Used violins. He used violins. Trumpet, sax, trombone, bass, piano, drums, all that.

I remember they talk about, was it a Williams that played trumpet? Trumpet, that's his son. That was his son. Was that John? George. George. George Williams. George Williams. George Williams. George Williams.
